(II)--a son of सम्राट् and उत्कला. Father of बिन्दुमती. भा. V. १५. १५.

(III)--His wife was ऊर्णा; had six sons in the first antara; then Gods laughed at ब्रह्मा seeking connec- tion with his daughter; these were born of हिरण्यकशिपु as Asuras, but were taken away by योगमाया; then they were born of देवकी and killed by Kamsa. भा. X. ८५. ४७-49.

(VI)--a son of ब्रह्मा married धर्मव्रता, the daughter of Dharma whom he cursed for dereliction of duty, to become a stone; got one hundred sons through her; in turn cursed by her for the unjust curse. वा. १०७. 7, २६; ११२. ३६.
(VII)--a mind-born son of ब्रह्मा; married सन्नती. Vi.

(I)--the gods of the ninth Manvantara; a गण of १२ gods. भा. VIII. १३. १९; Br.

--a daughter of a Bhoja king; wife of देवमीढ and mother of Vasudeva and others. भा. IX. २४. २७; Br. III. ७१. १४५.

(I)--a daughter of कण्डु and Pramloca (of Soma म्। प्।) (of plants and trees, शाखिन् ब्र्। प्।) brought up by trees and married to Pracetasas who were the ten sons of प्राचीनबर्हिस; mother of दक्ष: gave birth to trees, plants, and (R. चन्द्रवती (म्। प्।) In the previous birth, she was the queen of a king who died young. She became a widow with no son; prayed to the Lord who blessed her with ten righteous husbands. These were the Pracetasas and had a number of sons; she herself had a miraculous birth. भा. IV. ३०. १३ and ४७-9; Br.
(II)--the wife of शूर and mother of Vasudeva and others. Vi. IV. १४. २६-7. [page२-693+ ३४]

(I)--the name of a desert;
1: भा. I. १०. ३५.
water in, due to ignorance.

(II)--the son of शिघ्रराज and father of प्रश्रुत (प्रसुश्रक-वि। प्।); having attained perfection in योग: he [page२-639+ २६] resides in कलापग्राम (still rooted in Yoga-वि। प्।): would revive the solar race at the end of Kali. भा. IX. १२. 5-7; Br. III. ६३. २१०-11. Vi.
(III)--a son of हर्यश्व and father of प्रतीपक (Pratyambaka ब्र्। प्।; Pratitvaka-वा। प्।). भा. IX. १३. १५-6; Br. III. ६४. ११. वा. ८९. ११.
(V)--of the इक्ष्वाकु line, living in कलापग्राम and endowed with Yoga. भा.
(VI)--a son of the III सावर्ण Manu. Br.
(VII)--the place sacred to ललिता. Br. IV. ४४. ९८.
(IV)--on the way from द्वारका to हास्तिन- pura. भा. X. ७१. २१.
--१३ Kings of this line ruled for २०० years with वृषलस्. वा. ९९. ३६०, ३६३.
(I)--a son of Karandhama; he had no son and regarded दुष्यन्त of Puru's family as his son. भा. IX. २३. १७.

(I)--the son of अविक्षित्, a cakravarti and father of Dama; helped by Samvarta, he performed sacrifices; his यज्ञस् were of a high order; Indra was much pleased with सोम, and the Brahmanas with दक्षिणा; Maruts were the guards and विश्वेदेवस् were members of the सभा;
1: भा.

. २६-9.

(III)--a son of उशनस्, a great warrior and राजऋषि; father of Kambalabarhis. Br. III. ७०. २५: M. ४४. २४: वा. ९५. २४.

. ४७; १६३. २२-3.
when Diti conceived a son to be the slayer of Indra, the latter began to serve her throughout her pregnancy. Once finding that she did not keep to her vows he entered her womb and cut the foetus into ४९ pieces, when they cried. He said to them मा रुद and hence मारुत: being divine, were born as ४९ sons: at the request of their mother Indra made them a देवगण, called मरुत्गण.

(I)--the Sun God; ब्रह्मा placed the तेजस् of the अण्डम् in the गर्भ of अदिती and when everything became stunted, the God removed it from the गर्भ mak- [page२-697+ ३३] ing it into two pieces; finding the weakness of the गर्भ ब्रह्मा caused it to be placed in the lap of the Sun God; hence the name;
